pages.text: The Ogroid Hammer is a slow, heavy two-handed weapon. Hold Use for half a second with an empty offhand: 9 damage and knockback within 3 blocks. The 12-second cooldown is saved on the item. Walls block the wave; oils and fangs apply to ordinary hits only.
Griffin claws reinforce the striking head; an ogroid fang secures the core. Also drops from Bonecrushers.

Katakan fangs occupy the Trinkets necklace slot. Restore 10% of actual hostile HP loss: at most 2 HP per second and 4 HP over one victim’s lifetime. That reserve is shared across hunters and persists through reload. Copies, PvP, animals, ranged hits and Crushing Blow do not heal.
An alternative in the same slot: senses monsters within 16 blocks and reduces their damage by 5%. Forest and wraith essences stabilize its sensitive frame. It does not replace armor.
